apps.name: Ghost Hub
apps.description: Every Ghost app in one place. Install and update them anywhere, from GitHub or your PC.
changes: Update checks keep working after your phone restarts.
"Update all" shows how much it will download.
Downloaded installers are cleaned up once an app is installed.

apps.name: Ghost GPS
apps.description: Set your location anywhere: teleport, walk a route or steer with the joystick.
changes: There & back: long-press Loop to walk a route out and home along the same path, on repeat.
Long-press the status chip to copy your fake coordinates.
Clearer walking status while heading back on a route.

apps.name: Ghost Volume
apps.description: Your own volume for every app, switched automatically when you open it.
changes: Quick Settings tile: pause or resume per-app volume straight from the notification shade.
Long-press an app in your list to remove it quickly.

apps.name: Ghost Terminal
apps.description: A shell on your phone, with a side list of commands that work on your device.
changes: New 'history' command, plus '!!' to rerun the last command and '!7' to rerun line 7.
Opens in the folder you were last in, instead of starting over.

apps.name: Ghost Weather
apps.description: Live weather where you are and anywhere you save: hourly, 7-day, rain alerts at a glance.
changes: "2° warmer than this time yesterday" under the big temperature, so you know how to dress.
A Tomorrow pill on the front: emoji, high/low and rain chance at a glance.
The widget now shows today's rain chance too.

apps.name: Ghost School
apps.description: Homework, timetable, grades, targets, exams and revision, with XP, levels and badges.
changes: Two-week timetables: turn on Week A / Week B in the menu, and Home's now/next follows the right week.
Homework can have notes (page numbers, what to hand in), shown on the list and on Home.
The daily reminder now also warns about exams: the evening before and a week out. Pick its time in the menu.
The focus timer shows a live countdown in your notifications while you're in other apps.

apps.name: Ghost Image Editor
apps.description: Crop, rotate, filters, adjust, draw and add text to your photos. Nothing leaves your phone.
changes: Straighten: a tilt slider in Rotate fixes a wonky horizon, with a grid to line up against.
Pixelate and Marker brushes in Draw: blur out faces or private details before you share.
✨ Auto in Adjust gives a photo a quick lift in one tap.
Tap empty space to deselect text; a new photo no longer inherits the last one's vignette.

apps.name: Ghost VPN
apps.description: One-tap VPN through free volunteer servers in many countries. Tests servers from your phone to find the fastest.
changes: If the tunnel drops on its own, Ghost VPN now reconnects to the same country (turn off in the menu).
Tap your IP address to copy it.

apps.name: Ghost Browser
apps.description: A private browser: ad & tracker blocker, incognito tabs, and sites forget you when you leave.
changes: Print or save any page as a PDF from the menu, great for homework and tickets.
Text size setting (70–200%) with a live preview, for every page.
Tidier menu ordering.

apps.name: Ghost Video
apps.description: Video editor: trim, filters, colour, speed, rotate, captions and sound. Saved on your phone.
changes: Crop to a shape in Size: Square, Story 9:16, Portrait 4:5 or Wide 16:9, with a bright box showing what's kept.
The trim slider now sits on a film strip of your video, so you can see where you're cutting.
🔁 next to the seek bar repeats the trimmed part while you fine-tune it.
